subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should Voice/Talk use a Voice-owned agent/session selector, automatically mirror Chat selection, or defer multi-agent Voice routing until a shared companion-app active-agent model exists?
rationale: The source shows the missing behavior clearly, but the permanent UX and session-state owner affects multiple companion app surfaces and should not be chosen by cleanup automation.

options.title: Add Voice-owned selector
options.body: Expose an explicit Voice/Talk agent or session picker and route Talk/Mic turns through that selection without relying on hidden Chat state.

options.title: Mirror Chat selection
options.body: Make Voice follow the active Chat session, which is smaller UI work but creates cross-tab coupling users may not understand.

options.title: Defer shared routing
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers design one active-agent/session model for Chat, Voice, and companion-app parity.

recommendation.title: Add Voice-owned selector
recommendation.body: Expose an explicit Voice/Talk agent or session picker and route Talk/Mic turns through that selection without relying on hidden Chat state.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored Android Talk Mode and per-agent TTS and already summarized this issue’s remaining product boundary in the discussion.
